page.overview:
Who is Shemaen?

Shemaen is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

During the Aiel War, Shemaen is told by Adelorna Bastine about Gitara Moroso's Foretelling that the Last Battle will come during the lifetime of sisters now breathing. Ellid Abareim overhears this conversation and repeats it to her fellow Accepted, Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche.
